Command: Do not eat the second tithe outside Jerusalem
Summary: The command: Do not eat the second tithe outside Jerusalem (Deuteronomy 12:17). The second tithe was eaten before the LORD in the place he chose, in rejoicing before him.
Commandment: Do not eat the second tithe outside Jerusalem.
Application: It cannot be practised as written without the standing temple and Aaronic priesthood; its enduring lesson is God's holiness, the cost of atonement, and worship offered exactly as God appoints.
Purpose: Scripture's stated ground: the tithe was eaten before the LORD in the place he chose, that Israel might learn to fear the LORD always (Deuteronomy 14:23).
